type.description: A 'sprinkler' is set on tilled, empty soil of the plot from the item button, as a seed is planted, and taken up again with interact; each morning it waters the four cells beside it. A 'material' (stone, wood, ore, coal, a bar, a crystal) is neither eaten nor given, only carried, sold and made into things. 'food' is eaten from the item menu (its stats say what it gives); an 'ingredient' is only cooked with; a 'tool' works the farm from the item button (its stats name which tool it is); a 'seed' is planted from the item button (its stats name its crop).

icon.description: The item's picture (a frame of gameplay/art/items.png, ItemIcons.FRAMES). Without one, its type decides.

stats.description: Weapon stats. Damage is in enemy health points; ranged weapons name their ammo item id and arrow speed (px/s); bombs have a fuse (s) and blast radius (px); a lantern's radius is how far its light reaches (px).

energy.description: Food: the energy it gives when eaten.

hearts.description: Food: the hearts it mends when eaten (0.5 is half a heart).

crop.description: A seed: the id of the crop it plants (data/crops).

fewer_blows.description: A pickaxe: how many blows fewer than the plain one it needs to break a rock (never less than one blow). The copper pickaxe says 1, the iron one 2.

reach.description: A hoe or a watering can: how many cells in a line one use works, from the cell the hero faces onward. The copper ones say 2, the iron ones 3. The cell he faces decides whether the stroke is made; energy and the pour are paid once.

tool.description: 'pick' is the pickaxe, which strikes the rock the hero faces (data/rules/mine.json says how many blows each kind takes). A tool: 'hoe' tills bare soil; 'water' is the watering can, which waters tilled soil and names what it holds as its 'ammo' (that item's max_stack is how many pours it holds). 'cooldown' is how long one use takes (s).
